about: The angels with whom God is angry accuse Adam before him: he was given the whole creation, was set in the garden and warned of the one tree, yet he ate and was driven out. God answers on Adam's behalf, reminding them that they were made of fire and wind for praise, and that Adam, made of earth and water as well, has ten thoughts, five good and five evil; the angels, protesting they would never transgress, ask to be tested. The second part tells what follows.

sentences.n: Chapter heading; the numeral ፻ is 'hundred' (100), here printed as one sign. በእንተ 'concerning' governs the whole clause that follows. እለ ተዐደዉ is the plural relative እለ 'those who' + ተዐደዉ, the tä-stem perfect 3rd masculine plural of ዐደወ 'pass over, transgress' (the ተ- prefix and the plural ending -ዉ); መላእክት 'angels' stands in apposition, 'those who transgressed — angels'. The title is a little loose: the chapter shows angels who slandered Adam and with whom God was angry, and who then protest that they would never overstep his word; I keep the heading as printed.

sentences.l: And-there-is again angels-also who was-angry-with-them God, for knew-them, knower-of heart, which-they-slandered to-Adam, while they-say: after loved-him God and-gave-him us-also that-we-may-serve-him, and-livestock and-wild-beasts and-fish-of sea and-birds-of heaven and-all fruits and-trees-of wilderness, and-moreover heavens and-earth;
sentences.i: And there are also, again, angels with whom God was angry, because he, the knower of the heart, knew them: they had slandered Adam, saying, “After God loved him, he gave him even us, that we might serve him, and the livestock and the wild beasts and the fish of the sea and the birds of the sky and all fruits and the trees of the wilderness, and moreover the heavens and the earth;
sentences.n: The angels are introduced as the second group of transgressors. ወቦ is ወ- 'and' + ቦ 'there is' (existential); ካዕበ 'again'; the enclitic -ሂ 'also' on መላእክትሂ. እለ ተምዕዖሙ እግዚኣብሔር: the relative 'those who' with a resumptive pronoun, ተምዕዐ 'be angry with' + -ሙ 'them' (the suffix is attached to a perfect with ኦ, as in ቀተሎሙ 'killed them'), so literally 'who God was angry with them'. አእመሮሙ is አእመረ 'know' + -ሙ 'them'; ማእምረ ልብ 'knower of heart' is an epithet of God in the construct state (ማእምር + ልብ), standing in the accusative as apposition to the subject; compare Psalm 7:9, where God tests hearts. ዘሐመይዎ ለአዳም: ሐመየ 'slander' (as in ch. 76a, 97) (3rd plural perfect + -ኦ 'him', the object doubled by ለአዳም); the ዘ- is the singular relative/'that which' used after a plural, so I read it as 'what they had done, accusing him' (?). እንዘ ይብሉ 'while they say' opens the angels' speech, which I mark with an opening quotation mark; it runs on through the following units and closes at ፈጣሪሁ in unit 8 (the narrator then answers), and a second speech of the angels runs from unit 10 to ተዐደወ ትእዛዝከ in unit 15. እምድኅረ አፍቀሮ is እምድኅረ 'after' + perfect + -ኦ 'him'. ወወሀቦ ኪያነሂ: ወሀበ 'give' + -ኦ 'him', with ኪያነ 'us' (accusative pronoun) + -ሂ 'also' as the thing given; ከመ ንትለአኮ is ከመ 'that' + 1st plural subjunctive ንትለአከ 'we serve' + -ኦ 'him' (ከ+ኦ merge to ኮ). The list of gifts that follows (ወእንስሳ ወአራዊት ወዓሣተ ባሕር ወአዕዋፈ ሰማይ …) is all object of ወሀቦ, in the accusative, and echoes man's dominion in Genesis 1:26–28 and Psalm 8:6–8. ዓሣተ ባሕር, አዕዋፈ ሰማይ, ዕፀወ ገዳም are construct chains: 'fish of the sea', 'birds of the sky', 'trees of the wilderness'. ወዓዲ 'and moreover'.

sentences.i: and he gave him the heaven too, that it might give him rain, and the earth too, that it might give him fruit;
sentences.n: The angels' speech continues. ሰማይኒ and ምድርኒ carry the enclitic -ኒ 'also, and'. ከመ ተሀቦ is ከመ 'that' + ተሀቦ, the 3rd feminine singular subjunctive of ወሀበ 'give' (the regular form is ትሁብ; the spelling here is shortened) + -ኦ 'him'; ሰማይ and ምድር are treated as feminine here. ዝናመ 'rain' and ፍረያተ 'fruits' are accusative. Compare Genesis 1:11–12 (the earth bringing forth); the thought, that the whole creation was given to serve man, is the angels' grievance.

sentences.n: ፀሐየ and ወርኀ are the accusative of ፀሐይ 'sun' and ወርኅ 'moon', put first for emphasis before ወሀቦ 'he gave him'. ፀሐይኒ, ወርኅኒ again carry -ኒ. ያብርህ is the 3rd masculine singular subjunctive of አብርሀ (the a-stem of በርሀ 'be bright'), 'that it shine', after ከመ; ሎቱ 'to/for him'. በመዐልት 'by day' and በሌሊት 'by night' use the preposition በ- 'in/by'. sentences.l: Moulded-him with-his-fingers and-created-him in-his-likeness, and-kissed-him, and-breathed upon-him spirit-of life, and-said-to-him: my-son, my-firstborn and-my-beloved;
sentences.i: he moulded him with his fingers and made him in his likeness, and kissed him, and breathed upon him a spirit of life, and said to him, ‘My son, my firstborn and my beloved;’
sentences.n: A fine run of perfects, each with the object suffix -ኦ 'him' merged into the last consonant of the verb (ለሐኮ, ወፈጠሮ, ወሰዐሞ). ለሐከ 'knead, mould' (clay; the noun ልሕኵት 'moulded thing' recurs below) is the sense I take from the form and the later ልሕኵትየ (?); በአጻብዒሁ 'with his fingers' (በ- 'with' + plural of ጽብዕ 'finger' + -ሁ 'his'), as in Psalm 8:3. ፈጠሮ በአምሳሊሁ 'created him in his likeness' recalls Genesis 1:26–27. ሰዐሞ I read as ሰዐመ 'kiss' + -ኦ, 'and kissed him' (?); the kiss is not in Genesis. ወነፍሐ ላዕሌሁ መንፈሰ ሕይወት 'breathed upon him a spirit of life' is Genesis 2:7 (መንፈሰ is the accusative). ወይቤሎ is ወ- + ይቤ 'he said' + -ሎ 'to him'. ወልድየ, በኵርየ, ወፍቁርየ each have the first-person possessive -የ 'my': 'my son, my firstborn, and my beloved' (the three are in direct address, God's words to the newly made Adam).

sentences.i: and he set him in the garden, that he might eat and be glad, without sickness or pain, without toil or labour, and commanded him not to eat from one tree;
sentences.n: ሤሞ is ሠይመ 'set, appoint' + -ኦ 'him'; ውስተ ገነት 'into the garden' (Genesis 2:8, 15). ከመ ይብላዕ ወይትፈጋዕ: two 3rd masculine singular subjunctives after ከመ 'that', 'that he eat and that he be glad'; ይብላዕ is from በልዐ 'eat' and ይትፈጋዕ is the tä-stem of a root ፈግዐ 'rejoice, be merry' (?), the meaning from context. ዘእንበለ 'without' is repeated for each pair: ደዌ ወሕማም 'sickness and pain', ጻማ ወስራሕ 'toil and labour' (ስራሕ printed with ሰ; the lemma is spelled ሥራሕ, from ሠርሐ 'work'), a picture of life before the fall (compare Genesis 3:16–19). ወአዘዞ is ወ- + አዘዘ 'command' + -ኦ 'him'; ከመ ኢይብላዕ 'that he not eat' (ኢ negates the subjunctive); እምአሐቲ ዕፅ 'from one tree' (እም- 'from'; አሐቲ is the feminine 'one', so ዕፅ is feminine here, as in እምይእቲ ዕፅ below). Genesis 2:16–17.

sentences.l: And-this all after gave-him, transgressed and-ate from-that tree, and-became hated and-rejected, and-drove-him-out from-garden;
sentences.i: And after he had given him all this, he transgressed and ate from that tree, and became hateful and rejected, and he drove him out of the garden;
sentences.n: The subject changes mid-sentence, as the Geʿez does not say: እምድኅረ አወፈዮ 'after he gave him' has God as subject (አወፈየ 'give, bestow' + -ኦ), but ተዐደወ 'he transgressed' (the tä-stem singular perfect of ዐደወ, the verb of the chapter heading) and ወበልዐ 'and ate' are Adam, and ወሰደዶ is ሰደደ 'drive out' + -ኦ 'him', with God again as subject. ዘንተ ኵሎ 'all this' (accusative). እምይእቲ ዕፅ 'from that (feminine) tree'. ወኮነ ጽሉአ ወምኑነ: ኮነ 'became' takes a complement in the accusative, ጽሉአ 'hated, loathsome' and ምኑነ 'condemned, rejected' (ምኑን, as in ch. 2–8 'rejected'). Genesis 3:6, 23–24.

sentences.i: From now on, indeed, his hope is lost (?), for he has transgressed the commandment of his Maker.” And God answered the angels who had thus slandered Adam, and said to them, “Why do you slander Adam so? For he is flesh and blood, and he is dust and earth.”
sentences.n: The angels' speech ends at ፈጣሪሁ (my quotation mark closes there); then the narrator resumes with ወአውሥኦሙ. እምይእዜሰ is እም- 'from' + ይእዜ 'now' + the emphatic/contrastive -ሰ; ቀብጸ ተስፋሁ 'his hope' is the difficult part: ቀብጸ looks like a perfect of a root meaning 'be deprived of, lose (hope)' with ተስፋሁ accusative or subject, and I render 'his hope is lost' (?). እስመ ተዐደወ ትእዛዘ ፈጣሪሁ 'because he transgressed the commandment of his creator' (ትእዛዘ is the accusative of the construct, object of ተዐደወ; ፈጣሪሁ is ፈጣሪ 'maker' + -ሁ 'his'). ወአውሥኦሙ is አውሥአ 'answer' + -ሙ 'them', doubled by ለመላእክት 'the angels'; እለ ሐመይዎ ከመዝ ለአዳም 'who thus (ከመዝ = ከመ + ዝ) slandered him, Adam'. ወይቤሎሙ 'and said to them'. ለምንት 'why' (ለ- + ምንት 'what'). ተሐምይዎ is the 2nd plural imperfect of ሐመየ + -ኦ 'him': 'you accuse him'. The reply is ሥጋ ወደም 'flesh and blood', with ሐመድ 'dust' and መሬት 'earth' recalling Genesis 2:7 and 3:19 — the point being that Adam is frail.

sentences.n: ወአውሥኡ is the plural perfect of አውሥአ 'answer'; ወይቤልዎ is ወ- + ይቤሉ 'they said' + -ኦ 'to him'. ንንብብኑ is the 1st plural subjunctive of ነበበ 'speak' with the question enclitic -ኑ: 'may we speak?'. ቅድሜከ 'before you' (ቅድሜ + -ከ); እግዚኦ is the vocative 'O Lord'. ኀጢአቶ ለአዳም: the suffix -ኦ 'his' anticipates the owner named after with ለ-, 'his sin, Adam's' — a regular Geʿez way to say 'Adam's sin'. ንብቡ is the plural imperative of ነበበ. ወእሰምዐክሙ አነሂ: after the imperative, a 1st person singular imperfect/subjunctive ('and I will hear you', read as a promise) of ሰምዐ 'hear' + -ክሙ 'you (pl)'; አነሂ 'I also'. ወአወሥአክሙ 'and I will answer you'. በእንተ አዳም ገብርየ 'concerning Adam, my servant' (ገብር 'servant' + -የ).

God concerning Adam, for said: created-him from-earth, and-not-he-forsakes-him, to-my-moulded-work, I-brought-him from-where there-was-not, and-not-he-makes-him mockery(?)-of his-enemy, to-the-work-of my-hands; and-said those angels: glory to-you, O-Lord, for you-know-us, knower-of hearts, that we-slandered-him to-Adam on-account-of (him)-who-transgressed commandment-of yours, that not-he-eat from-one tree, after you-made-him-ruler over all which you-created, and-set-him over all work-of your-hands;
sentences.i: For God took up Adam’s cause (?), for he said, “I made him from the earth, and I will not forsake him, my moulded work; I brought him from where he was not, and I will not make him the mockery (?) of his enemy, him, the work of my hands.” And those angels said, “Glory to you, O Lord, for you know us, O knower of hearts, that we slandered Adam because he transgressed your commandment, that he not eat from one tree, after you made him ruler over all that you created and set him over all the work of your hands;
sentences.n: This unit runs to about fifty words but has no ፤ inside it, so I keep it whole. It is also hard because the persons shift: it begins with the narrator (እስመ ተኬነወ እግዚኣብሔር 'for God ... on account of Adam'), then quotes God's own words (ይቤ 'he said': ፈጠርክዎ 'I made him', አምጻእክዎ 'I brought him'), though in the middle ኢይገድፎ and ኢይሬስዮ are 3rd person (ይገድፍ / ይሬስይ + -ኦ 'him'), as if the speech slid from 'he' to 'I'; I translate them in the first person as God's own words, but the Geʿez has 'he'. ተኬነወ is a tä-stem perfect of a root I cannot confirm, 'was zealous for / took up the cause of' (?) from the context only. ፈጠርክዎ እመሬት 'I created him from the earth' (Genesis 2:7); ወኢይገድፎ ለልሕኵትየ: ገደፈ 'leave, forsake' + -ኦ 'him', doubled by ለልሕኵትየ 'my moulded thing' (ልሕኵት + -የ; the noun is that of ለሐከ in unit 5). አምጻእክዎ እምኀበ ኢሀሎ 'I brought him from where he was not' (the place where there was not); ኢሀሎ is ኢ- + ሀሎ 'there was'. ኢይሬስዮ ስላተ ጸላኢሁ: ረሰየ 'make' + -ኦ, with a second object ስላተ, which I take as 'mockery' (?) — the lemma and sense are uncertain, 'spoil, prey' being the other possibility; ጸላኢሁ 'his enemy' (ጸላኢ + -ሁ). ለግብረ እደዊየ doubles the object -ኦ: 'him, the work of my hands' (a construct chain, as Psalm 8:6 and 138:8). Then the angels: ወይቤሉ እሙንቱ መላእክት 'and those angels said'; ስብሐት ለከ 'glory be to you'. አእመርከነ is አእመረ 'know' + 2nd singular -ከ + -ነ 'us', 'you know us'; ማእምረ አልባብ 'knower of hearts' (plural of ልብ) is the epithet from unit 2, here a vocative. ከመ ሐመይናሁ ለአዳም: the 1st plural perfect of ሐመየ 'slander' + -ሁ 'him'. በእንተ ዘተዐደወ is 'on account of (him) who / that he transgressed'. ትእዛዘ ዚአከ 'the commandment of yours'. አመስፈንኮ is the denominative verb from መስፍን 'ruler, prince' (አመስፈነ 'make ruler'), 2nd singular + -ኦ 'him' (?); ሤምኮ ሠይመ + 2nd singular + -ኦ 'you set him', as in unit 6. Psalm 8:6.

sentences.i: And if you had not told him, and had not commanded him not to eat from that tree, it would not have been a fault in him; and even if he had eaten in the sin of eating (?), it would not have been a fault;
sentences.n: The angels now argue that without the commandment there would be no blame; the conditional is loose in the Geʿez, with እመ 'if' repeated, and I read the last clause of each half as the result (?). ወሶበ 'and when / and if', እመ 'if'. ኢነገርኮ is ኢ- + ነገረ 'tell' in the 2nd singular (-ከ) + -ኦ 'him' (ከ+ኦ merge to ኮ), and ኢአዘዝኮ likewise 'you did not command him'. ከመ ኢይብላዕ 'that he not eat' (as in unit 6). ኢኮኖ is ኢ- + ኮነ 'it was' + -ኦ 'to him': 'it would not have been (counted) to him'; ጌጋየ is the accusative of ጌጋይ 'fault, error', the complement. ወሶበኒ 'and even when' (-ኒ 'also'). በኀጢአ መብልዕ 'in the sin of food' (መብልዕ 'food', what is eaten; I give 'eating' in i as the sense (?)); ኀጢአ looks like the construct of ኀጢአት 'sin' shortened (?), and the phrase may mean no more than 'by the offence of eating'. Compare the tension in Romans 4:15, 'where there is no law there is no transgression', named only as a parallel.

sentences.n: አላ 'but'. አጠየቆ ቃለከ: አጠየቀ is the causative of ጠየቀ 'be exact, certain', with -ኦ 'him'; the form is active 3ms (a 2nd-singular አጠየቅኮ would be expected after ወትቤሎ), and ቃለከ 'your word' is its object, so the sense I give, 'you made your word exact for him', takes the unexpressed subject from the context (?). ወትቤሎ is ወ- + ትቤ 'you said' (2nd singular; the same spelling is 3rd feminine 'she said', the only use in the published entry) + -ሎ 'to him'. እመ በሊዐ ትበልዕ and ሞተ ትመውት each pair an infinitive in the accusative with the imperfect of the same verb, the Geʿez way to strengthen: 'eating you will eat', 'dying you will die' (Genesis 2:17). እምዝንቱ ዕፅ 'from this tree'.

sentences.i: You did not let him lack anything to eat, sweet fruits from the garden; nor did you let him lack one to comfort him, or a companion like him to help him;
sentences.n: A reproach set against the generosity of God. ኢያኅጣእኮ is ኢ- + the causative (a-stem) of ኀጥአ 'lack, be missing' + -ከ-ኦ 'you ... him', 'you did not make him lack'; the printed ያ- (where a 2nd-singular perfect has አ-) is unexplained, so the person is read from the sense (?). ዘይበልዕ is ዘ- 'that which' + the imperfect ይበልዕ 'he eats' (so 'something to eat'), with ጥዑመ ፍረያተ 'sweet fruits', accusative. ዘይናዝዞ 'one who comforts him' (ናዘዘ 'comfort' + -ኦ) and ዘይረድኦ 'who helps him' (ረድአ 'help' + -ኦ), both ዘ- 'who' + imperfect. ወቢጸ is ወ- 'and' + ቢጽ 'companion, fellow' in the accusative (ቢጸ); ዘይናዝዞ and ዘይረድኦ are parallel relative clauses, 'one who comforts him and a companion who helps him', so the ወ is the conjunction, as l and i have it, not the first letter of a word ወቢጽ. ከማሁ 'like him' (ከማ + -ሁ), making this a reference to the 'helper like him' of Genesis 2:18, that is Eve.

sentences.i: The Merciful One, the lover of mercy, answered them on Adam’s behalf, and said to them, “You, for your part, I made of one mind, for glory, from fire and wind; but him I made twofold compared with you (?), from earth and from water, from wind and fire;
sentences.n: A new unit begins with a new speech of God: the narrator names him by two titles, መሓሪ 'merciful (one)' and መፍቀሬ ምሕረት 'lover of mercy' (መፍቀሬ is the construct of መፍቀሪ 'lover', from አፍቀረ 'love'), both in apposition to the unnamed subject of አውሥኦሙ 'he answered them' (አውሥአ + -ሙ). ህየንተ አዳም 'in place of / on behalf of Adam'. አንትሙሰ 'you (plural), for your part' (-ሰ contrast). ፩ ኅሊና: the numeral ፩ 'one' is printed separately from ኅሊና 'thought, mind' (in ch. 99 the numerals were printed attached, as ፪አግብርተ; here they stand apart, as printed); ፈጠርኩክሙ is ፈጠረ + 1st singular -ኩ + -ክሙ 'you (pl)': 'I created you'. ለስብሐት 'for glory/praise'. እምእሳት ወነፋስ 'from fire and wind (spirit)': angels are fire and wind, as in Psalm 104:4. ሎቱሰ ፈጠርክዎ: ሎቱ 'to him' marks the object by ለ- and -ሰ 'as for' contrast; ፈጠርክዎ 'I made him' (-ክዎ is the 1st singular + -ኦ). ምክዕቢተ ዚአክሙ I read as 'a doubling of yours', ምክዕቢት (an accusative noun related to ከዐበ 'double, fold') + ዚአክሙ 'yours (pl)' (?); the sense fits what follows, since man is made of four elements, earth and water as well as wind and fire (Genesis 2:7, 3:19), twice the angels' two. እመሬት ወእማይ 'from earth and from water' (እም- 'from' repeated).

sentences.n: The numerals are printed apart: ፲ ፡ ኅሊናተ 'ten thoughts' (ኅሊናተ the accusative plural of ኅሊና), ፭ ፡ ዘሠናያት 'five of good', and ወ፭ ዘእኩይ 'and five of evil' (here the ወ 'and' is attached to the numeral). ቦቱ 'in him (there are)'. ዘሠናያት is ዘ- 'of' + plural 'good things'; ዘእኩይ the singular 'of evil'. ለእመ and ለእመሰ 'if' (ወ- + ለእመ; the second with -ሰ 'but, indeed'). አጥብዐ ልቡ ለሠናይ: the causative አጥብዐ 'make firm' (from ጠብዐ, unit 13), ልቡ 'his heart' (object; the printed form shows no distinct accusative vowel), ለሠናይ 'for good'. የሐውር 'he walks, goes' (imperfect of ሐወረ) in the result clause; በኅሊና ሠናይ 'in a good thought'. አስሐቶ is አስሐተ 'lead astray' (causative, from the root of ስሕተት 'error') + -ኦ 'him'; ዲያብሎስ 'the devil' is the subject. የሐውር ኀቤሁ 'he goes to him' (ኀቤ 'to, with' + -ሁ); በፍኖት እኩይ 'by an evil way' (ፍኖት 'way, path'). The doctrine of the ten thoughts, five good and five evil, is not in Scripture; I name no parallel.

sentences.i: And when you were like him, and I made you from water and earth, being flesh and blood, and since you went beyond him, overstepping (?) my commandment and denying my word —”
sentences.n: This is the hardest unit and I am not sure of it. ወሶበ ኮንክሙ ከማሁ 'and when you were like him' (ኮንክሙ the 2nd plural perfect of ኮነ; ከማሁ 'like him'). ወፈጠርኩክሙ እማይ ወመሬት 'and I made you from water and earth' (God says this of the angels, who were fire and wind in unit 16; the clash with unit 16 suggests the whole clause is a condition 'if you were...', not a statement of fact (?)). እምኮንክሙ ሥጋ ወደም: እም- 'from' + perfect 'since you were / after you became flesh and blood'. ወእምአፈድፈድክሙ እምኔሁ 'and since you surpassed him' (አፈድፈደ 'exceed, do more', 2nd plural; እምኔሁ 'than him'). Then ዐሊ ወ ትእዛዝየ ወክሒደ ቃልየ: the printed ወ between spaces is an oddity, kept as printed. I read ዐሊ ወ as one word ዐሊወ, the accusative infinitive of ዐለወ 'overstep, pass beyond' (cf. ኢነዐሉ in unit 23) split by a stray wordspace, with ትእዛዝየ 'my commandment' as its object, parallel to ወክሒደ ቃልየ 'and denying my word' (ክሒደ the accusative infinitive of ከሐደ 'deny'), so no 'and' before ትእዛዝየ (?). The sentence has no stated result and stops abruptly, so I end it with a dash (?).

(?), and ለነ 'for/to us', so 'far be it from us', with the Geʿez negative ኢ- on the next two verbs: ኢንትዐደው is ኢ- + ንትዐደው, the 1st plural subjunctive of ተዐደወ 'transgress' (the verb of the heading), and ኢነዐሉ is ኢ- + ንዐሉ, the 1st plural subjunctive of ዐለወ 'pass beyond'; ትእዛዝከ and ቃለከ 'your commandment', 'your word' are objects. እስመ ንሕነ 'for we'; መንፈሳዊያን 'spiritual ones' and መሬታዊ 'earthly' are the predicates, ለሕይወት 'for life' against ለእበድ 'for folly' (እበድ, if it is that, 'folly, madness'; the contrast with life suggests it may mean 'perdition' (?)). ወውእቱሰ 'and he, for his part'.

sentences.l: And-now if we-can exactly test-us and-try-us, that-you-may-know whether we-can to-keep word-yours.
sentences.i: and now, if we are able, test us strictly and try us, that you may know whether we can keep your word.”
sentences.n: ወይእዜኒ 'and now' (ይእዜ + -ኒ). እመ ንክል 'if we are able' (ክህለ 'be able', 1st plural imperfect/subjunctive); ጥዩቀ 'exactly, strictly' (the accusative of ጥዩቅ used as an adverb; it could belong to ንክል 'if we are able exactly' (?)). ፍትነነ is ፈተነ 'test' (imperative) + -ነ 'us', and ወአመክረነ is አመከረ 'try, prove' + -ነ 'us'. ከመ ታእምር 'that you may know' (2nd singular subjunctive of አእመረ); ለእመ 'whether'; ዐቂበ ቃልከ 'to keep your word' (ዐቂበ the accusative infinitive of ዐቀበ 'keep, guard'). The angels offer to be tested, as Adam was; the chapter's second part gives the result.

glossary.አጠየቆ: አጠየቀ — he made exact, made sure (3ms perfect, causative of ጠየቀ, + -ኦ '3ms him'); read as 'you made your word exact for him', the subject taken from the context (?)
glossary.አጥብዐ: አጥብዐ — he strengthened, steadied (3ms perfect, ʾa-stem, ṭ-b-ʿ; the base verb is not established) (?)
glossary.ኢሀሎ: ሀሎ — he/it was not (ኢ- + 3ms perfect of ሀሎ 'be, exist'); እምኀበ ኢሀሎ 'from where he was not'
glossary.ኢነገርኮ: ነገረ — you did not tell him (ኢ- + 2ms perfect + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ኢንትዐደው: ተዐደወ — that we not transgress (ኢ- + 1cp subjunctive, tä-stem, ንትዐደው)
glossary.ኢአዘዝኮ: አዘዘ — you did not command him (ኢ- + 2ms perfect + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ኢኮኖ: ኮነ — it was not to him (ኢ- + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 'to him'; 'it would not have been counted to him')
glossary.ኢያኅጣእኮ: አኅጠአ — you did not make him lack (ኢ- + causative of ኀጥአ 'lack, be missing', + -ከ + -ኦ '3ms him'); the printed ያ- is irregular for a 2ms perfect, so the person is read from the sense (?)
glossary.ኢይብላዕ: በልዐ — that he not eat; here 'break, void' (a figure) (ኢ- + 3ms subjunctive, G, b-l-ʿ) (?) · that he not eat (plain, ኢ- + 3ms subjunctive of በልዐ 'eat', ከመ ኢይብላዕ እምአሐቲ ዕፅ 'that he not eat from one tree')
glossary.እመ: እመ — if (conjunction) · whether (ጐንደይኩ እመ ትገብእ 'I waited whether she would return') · in case, perhaps (እመ ይሁበከ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'perhaps God may give you offspring') · mother (እም, accusative, predicate: ወኮነተኪ እመ 'and she became a mother to you')
glossary.እመሬት: መሬት — from the ground, dirt (እም- + noun)
glossary.እማኅበርክሙ: ማኅበር — from your assembly, company (እም- + noun + -ክሙ '2mp your')
glossary.እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of') · from where (እምኀበ ኢሀሎ 'from where there was not', before a clause)
glossary.እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel') · 'above' in ተሰብሐ እምነ ኵሎሙ 'was praised above (?) all of them', or possibly the agent 'by' (?)
glossary.እምኔሁ: እም — from (preposition + -ሁ 'him, it', 3ms, form እምኔ-) · 'than it', in comparison (ልብሰ ዘይኄይስ እምኔሁ 'a garment better than it')
glossary.እምአሐቲ: አሐዱ — from one (እም- + numeral, fem. አሐቲ)
glossary.እምኮንክሙ: ኮነ — since you were, after you became (እም- + 2mp perfect ኮንክሙ)
glossary.እምዝንቱ: ዝንቱ — from this (እም- + demonstrative masc. sg.)
glossary.እምይእቲ: ይእቲ — from that (እም- + ይእቲ, 3fs pronoun used as demonstrative 'that (fem.)': እምይእቲ ዕፅ 'from that tree')
glossary.እምይእዜሰ: ይእዜ — from now on, indeed (እም- + ይእዜ 'now' + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እደዊከ: እድ — your hands (noun, plural እደው, stem እደዊ- + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.እደዊየ: እድ — my hands (noun, plural እደው, stem እደዊ- + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
glossary.ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
glossary.ኮንክሙ: ኮነ — you became (2mp perfect, G, k-w-n, ending -ክሙ)
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ወ: ወ — and (conjunction, written as a separate word before ይቤሉ) · also a separate word before በደኃሪ ባሕር ('and in the last sea') · also a separate word before አንሥኦ ('and he raised', ወ ፡ አንሥኦ ለትሑት) · also, apparently, the last syllable of ዐሊወ cut off by a stray wordspace (ዐሊ ወ ትእዛዝየ 'overstepping my commandment', not 'and') (?)
glossary.ወሀቦ: ወሀበ — he gave him (3ms perfect + -ኦ 3ms object) · with the -ኦ anticipating a ለ- phrase (ወሀቦ ለወልዱ 'he gave him, to his son') · give him! (ወ- + 2ms imperative ሀብ + -ኦ '3ms him', ወሀቦ ወለተከ 'give him your daughter')
glossary.ወለእመ: እመ — and if (ወ- + ለእመ, conditional conjunction)
glossary.ወለእመሰ: እመ — and if indeed, but if (ወ- + ለእመ + enclitic -ሰ contrastive)
glossary.ወሎቱሰ: ለ — and him, as for him (ወ- + ሎቱ 'to him' + contrastive -ሰ; ለ- marks the object, ወሎቱሰ ፈጠርክዎ 'but him I created')
glossary.ወመፍቀሬ: መፍቀሪ — and lover of (ወ- + agent noun from አፍቀረ 'love', construct state 'lover-of')
glossary.ወምኑነ: ምኑን — and rejected, despised (ወ- + passive participle, accusative)
glossary.ወምድርኒ: ምድር — and earth also (ወ- + noun + enclitic -ኒ 'also'; treated as feminine)
glossary.ወሤምኮ: ሤመ — and you set him, appointed him (ወ- + 2ms perfect + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወሤሞ: ሤመ — and he appointed him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, ś-y-m + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወሰዐሞ: ሰዐመ — and he kissed him (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 'him'; the part kissed is a second accusative)
glossary.ወሰደዶ: ሰደደ — and he drove him out (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወስራሕ: ሥራሕ — and labour, work (ወ- + noun; printed ስራሕ with ሰ, the dictionary spelling being with ሠ, from ሠርሐ 'work')
glossary.ወሶበ: ሶበ — and when (ወ- + conjunction) · and Sobo (ወ- + proper name ሶበ, in the list of lands ruled by the Ishmaelites, ወሶበ ወኵርጒ; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወበልዐ: በልዐ — and it ate, devoured (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-l-ʿ)
glossary.ወቢጸ: ቢጽ — and a companion, fellow (ወ- 'and' + noun ቢጽ, accusative ቢጸ; ዘይናዝዞ … ወቢጸ ዘይረድኦ 'one who comforts him … and a companion who helps him')
glossary.ወቦ: ቦ — and there is (ወ- + existential ቦ 'there is')
glossary.ወቦቱ: በ — and with it (ወ- + preposition በ- with 3ms suffix ቦቱ) · 'and with him (were)', i.e. 'he had' (possession, ወቦቱ ክብረ ወብዕለ 'and he had glory and riches')
glossary.ወተስዕረ: ተሰዕረ — and he was defeated, cast out (?) (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ሰዐረ) (?)
glossary.ወትቤሎ: ይቤ — and she said to him (ወ- + 3fs ትቤ of defective ይቤ + -ሎ '3ms to him') · and you said to him (ወ- + 2ms ትቤ 'you said' + -ሎ '3ms to him'; the spelling is the same as 3fs 'she said')
glossary.ወነፍሐ: ነፍሐ — and he breathed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, n-f-ḥ)
glossary.ወአመክረነ: አመከረ — and try us! (ወ- + 2ms imperative, causative, + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወአራዊት: አርዌ — and wild beasts (ወ- + plural አራዊት)
glossary.ወአንትሙሰ: አንትሙ — and you (pl.), for your part (ወ- + 2mp pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወአንትሙኒ: አንትሙ — and you too (ወ- + 2mp pronoun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወአእመርከነ: አእመረ — and you know us (ወ- + 2ms perfect + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወአወሥአክሙ: አውሥአ — and I will answer you (ወ- + 1cs imperfect/subjunctive, causative, w-ś-ʾ, + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ወአውሥኡ: አውሥአ — and they answered (ወ- + causative 3mp perf., w-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወአውሥኦሙ: አውሥአ — and he answered them (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative-type stem + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወአዕዋፈ: ዖፍ — and birds (ወ- + plural አዕዋፍ, accusative)
glossary.ወአዘዞ: አዘዘ — and he commanded him (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወኢነዐሉ: ዐለወ — and that we not overstep, pass beyond (ወ- + ኢ- + 1cp subjunctive ንዐሉ) (?)
glossary.ወኢያኅጣእኮ: አኅጠአ — and you did not make him lack (ወ- + ኢ- + causative of ኀጥአ 'lack', + -ከ + -ኦ '3ms him'); the printed ያ- is irregular for a 2ms perfect, so the person is read from the sense (?)
glossary.ወኢይሬስዮ: ረሰየ — and he does not make him (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect + -ኦ '3ms him'; takes a second accusative; inside God's speech, read as 'I will not make him')
glossary.ወኢይገድፎ: ገደፈ — and he does not forsake him (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect + -ኦ '3ms him'; inside God's speech, read as 'I will not forsake him')
glossary.ወእማይ: ማይ — and from water (ወ- + እም- 'from' + noun)
glossary.ወእምአፈድፈድክሙ: አፈድፈደ — and since you surpassed, exceeded (ወ- + እም- + 2mp perfect, ʾäfäddäfä)
glossary.ወእሰምዐክሙ: ሰምዐ — and I will hear you (ወ- + 1cs imperfect/subjunctive + -ክሙ '2mp you'; a promise)
glossary.ወእንስሳ: እንስሳ — and livestock, animals (ወ- + collective noun, accusative)
glossary.ወከሠትነ: ከሠተ — and we revealed, disclosed (ወ- + 1cp perfect)
glossary.ወክሒደ: ከሐደ — and denying (ወ- + accusative infinitive of ከሐደ 'deny')
glossary.ወኮነ: ኮነ — and it was, became (ወ- + 3m sg perfect)
glossary.ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
glossary.ወወሀቦ: ወሀበ — and he gave him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-h-b + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወወርኀ: ወርኅ — and moon (ወ- + noun, accusative; also 'month')
glossary.ወወርኅኒ: ወርኅ — and the moon also (ወ- + noun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወዓሣተ: ዓሣ — and fish (ወ- + plural ዓሣት, accusative/construct 'fish of')
glossary.ወዓዲ: ዓዲ — and still, also, moreover (ወ- + adverb)
glossary.ወዕፀወ: ዕፅ — and trees of (ወ- + plural ዕፀው, accusative, construct 'trees of')
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወይቤሉ: ብህለ — and they said (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l)
glossary.ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወይትፈጋዕ: ፈግዐ — and that he be glad, rejoice (ወ- + 3ms subjunctive, tä-stem, f-g-ʿ; the root is read from the context) (?)
glossary.ወፈጠርኩክሙ: ፈጠረ — and I created you (ወ- + 1cs perfect + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ወፈጠሮ: ፈጠረ — and he created him (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወፍቁርየ: ፍቁር — and my beloved (ወ- + passive participle 'beloved' + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
glossary.ዐሊ: ዐለወ — overstepping (first part of ዐሊወ, the accusative infinitive of ዐለወ 'overstep', split from its ወ by a stray wordspace in the printed text; ዐሊ ወ ትእዛዝየ 'overstepping my commandment'; cf. ኢነዐሉ) (?)
glossary.ዕቡይ: ዕቡይ — proud, arrogant (adj.) · the proud one, used as a noun (ዕቡይ ወጽኑዕ 'the proud and strong one'; ዕቡይ as predicate 'Satan the proud one')
glossary.ዘሐመይዎ: ሐመየ — which they slandered him (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect + -ዎ '3ms him'; ዘሐመይዎ ለአዳም 'whom they had slandered, Adam')
glossary.ዘሠናያት: ሠናይ — of good ones, of good things (ዘ- + plural ሠናያት)
glossary.ዘሥጋ: ሥጋ — of flesh (ዘ- + noun; 'the law of the flesh')
glossary.ዘተዐደወ: ተዐደወ — who transgressed, departed (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, tä-stem of ዐደወ) · who surpassed (ዘተዐደወ እምጥበበ ሰብእ 'who surpassed the wisdom of men')
glossary.ዘአሥረጻ: አሥረጸ — who made it sprout (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect, causative of ሠረጸ, + -a 'it')
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘእኩይ: እኩይ — of evil (ዘ- + adjective singular, used as a noun)
glossary.ዘይረድኦ: ረድአ — who helps him (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ዘይበልዕ: በልዐ — which he eats (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ዘይናዝዞ: ናዘዘ — who comforts him (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ዘፈጠርከ: ፈጠረ — which you created (ዘ- relative + 2ms perfect)
glossary.ዚአክሙ: ዚአ — your (possessive pronoun ዚአ + -ክሙ '2mp your'; 'in the command of yours')
glossary.ዝናመ: ዝናም — rain (noun, accusative) · construct 'rain of' (ዝናመ እሳት 'rain of fire')
glossary.የሐውር: ሖረ — he walks, goes (3ms imperfect, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ያብርህ: አብርሀ — that it shine (3ms subjunctive after ከመ, ʾa-stem causative of በርሀ 'be bright', b-r-h)
glossary.ይብሉ: ብህለ — they say (3mp subjunctive/imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying') · 'let them say, let them call' (3mp jussive, ሎሙሰ ይብሉ አማልክቲሆሙ 'as for them, let them call them their gods')
glossary.ይብላዕ: በልዐ — that he eat (3ms subjunctive after ከመ, G, b-l-ʿ)
glossary.ጠብዐ: ጠብዐ — he was firm, obstinate, hardened (3ms perfect); the sense is taken from the context (?)
glossary.ጥዑመ: ጥዑም — sweet (adjective, accusative, before መባልዕተ) · predicate accusative after ኮነ (ይኩን ጥዑመ 'let it be sweet'; ማይ መሪር ይከውን ጥዑመ 'bitter water becomes sweet')
glossary.ጥዩቀ: ጥዩቅ — certain, exact; 'certainly' (adjective, accusative/adverbial form in -a)
glossary.ጽሉአ: ጽሉእ — hated, loathsome (adjective, accusative, predicate after ኮነ)
glossary.ፈጠርኩክሙ: ፈጠረ — I created you (1cs perfect + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ፈጠርክዎ: ፈጠረ — I created him (1cs perfect ፈጠርኩ + -ኦ '3ms him', -ክዎ)
glossary.፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants') · 'one' as a pronoun, 'one … another' (ይነግሮ ፩ ለካልኡ 'one tells another'; ch. 53) · 'anyone' after a negative or ዘእንበለ (ዘእንበለ ያእምር ፩ 'without anyone knowing') · 'one' before ኅሊና (፩ ኅሊና 'one mind, of one mind'), spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu), the masculine, since ኅሊና takes masculine agreement in this part (ባዕደ ኅሊና, በኅሊና ሠናይ)
glossary.፭: ፭ — 5, spoken ኀምስቱ (ḫaməstu) 'five'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'five' (፭ ስሑታን 'five erring ones'; spoken ኀምስቱ before a masculine) · spoken ኀምስ (ḫaməs) before a feminine noun (፭ ዓመተ 'five years')
